dialogues.speaker: Troubled Lianne
dialogues.text: For me, a true delicacy has to be something that's made using only the very freshest ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Troubled Lianne
dialogues.text: In fairness, most chefs in Mondstadt do use fresh produce from Springvale...

dialogues.speaker: Troubled Lianne
dialogues.text: But I still feel safer when I've gone out and collected my ingredients myself.
